items.headline: Goldman Sachs Upgrades Indian Equities to 'Overweight', Sets Nifty 50 Target at 28,500 by End 2027
items.summary: Goldman Sachs has upgraded its outlook on Indian equities to 'overweight', driven by strong domestic demand, robust earnings growth, and low foreign investor positioning. They project India's real GDP growth at 7.9% for 2026 and 7.2% for 2027, anticipating Nifty 50 to reach 28,500 by late 2027.

items.headline: RBI Expected to Hike Repo Rates as Inflation Forecasted to Rise to 5.7%
items.summary: Goldman Sachs anticipates India's inflation could climb to 5.7%, potentially prompting the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to implement further repo rate hikes.

items.headline: Bank of Maharashtra and South Indian Bank Announce MCLR Rate Hikes
items.summary: Bank of Maharashtra increased its overnight MCLR by 80 bps to 7.75% and its one-month MCLR by 50 bps to 8.30%. South Indian Bank also revised its MCLR rates, with the one-year MCLR set at 9.55%.

items.headline: Indian Rupee Expected to Stabilize Around 96 Against US Dollar
items.summary: Goldman Sachs projects that the Indian Rupee will stabilize around 96 against the US dollar over the next 12 months.

items.headline: Indian Markets Poised for Cautious Opening Amid Mixed Global Cues
items.summary: Indian stock markets are expected to open lower, reflecting mixed global sentiment with Wall Street closing mixed and most Asian markets trading subdued, despite US stock futures showing gains.

items.headline: Crude Oil Prices Remain a Factor for India's Economy
items.summary: Brent crude futures are trading around $92-$93 per barrel, and US crude oil futures at approximately $83 per barrel. A moderation in these prices would be beneficial for India, a major oil importer.

items.headline: FIIs Continue Buying Spree While DIIs Show Mixed Activity
items.summary: Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) remained net buyers, purchasing ₹5,866.78 crore on November 18. Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) net sold ₹3,159.90 crore on the same day but were net buyers on November 17.

items.headline: BLS Polymers Reports Strong Q2 Results with Revenue Up 30% YoY
items.summary: BLS Polymers announced a 30% year-on-year increase in Q2 revenue, with EBITDA up 2.8x and Profit After Tax (PAT) rising 2.29x, indicating robust performance.

items.headline: Bharat Electronics Achieves 25.97% YoY Revenue Growth in H1 FY27
items.summary: Bharat Electronics reported a significant 25.97% year-on-year growth in H1 FY27 revenue from operations and holds a strong order book of ₹68,717 crore as of October 1.

items.headline: Tata Steel Posts Solid Q2 FY27 Results Driven by India Deliveries
items.summary: Tata Steel recorded consolidated Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹65,436 crore and EBITDA of ₹10,665 crore, supported by a 16% quarter-on-quarter rise in India deliveries.

items.headline: Uno Minda and Gabriel India Deliver Robust Q2FY27 Performance
items.summary: Uno Minda saw revenue, EBITDA, and adjusted PAT grow 38%, 53%, and 38% YoY respectively. Gabriel India also showcased strong Q2FY27, with revenue, EBITDA, and adjusted PAT growing 23%, 12%, and 15% YoY.

items.headline: Morgan Stanley Projects Indian Equities to 'Regain Mojo' in 2026, Sensex Target 95,000-107,000
items.summary: Morgan Stanley anticipates Indian equities will recover significantly in 2026, setting a base-case Sensex target of 95,000 by December 2027 and a bull-case of 107,000 by December 2026. They favor financials, consumer discretionary, and industrials.

items.headline: Jefferies Expects Large-Cap Stocks to Benefit from Resurgent FPI Flows
items.summary: Jefferies believes large-cap stocks, especially in financials (HDFC Bank, Axis Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank) and major industrials like Reliance Industries and UltraTech Cement, will gain from a potential reversal in Foreign Portfolio Investor (FPI) flows.

items.headline: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO Opens for Subscription Today
items.summary: The Initial Public Offering (IPO) of Mahanadi Coalfields, a subsidiary of Coal India, opens for subscription today, November 19, with a price band of ₹129–₹136 per share.

items.headline: Sky Gold & Diamond Board Approves Raising Up to ₹1,800 Crore via Public/Private Offerings
items.summary: Sky Gold and Diamond's board has approved plans to raise up to ₹1,800 crore through public or private offerings, including a Qualified Institutional Placement (QIP).

items.headline: NALCO Signs MoU with RUSAL for Scandium Recovery from Red Mud
items.summary: National Aluminium Company (NALCO) has entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with RUSAL to collaborate on the recovery of Scandium from Red Mud.

items.headline: Physicswallah Targets Significant Revenue Growth to ₹9,000–₹10,000 Crore by FY30
items.summary: Physicswallah expects its revenue to grow substantially, aiming to reach ₹9,000–₹10,000 crore by FY30, up from ₹3,900 crore in FY26.

items.headline: Market Experts Identify Sun TV Network, Dr Reddy's, GAIL, Adani Power as Top Stock Picks
items.summary: Market experts have recommended Sun TV Network, Dr Reddy's Laboratories, GAIL, and Adani Power as strong stock picks for the day, projecting potential gains of 4-8%.
